limits: Stock .NET 10.0.403 generated a baseline lockfile from independently pinned NuGet.org archives in a private file feed. It used an unchanged copy of the lockfile to restore Polly and Polly.Core 8.5.2 exclusively through cratectl with fresh caches, repeated after restart, and honored review revocation. Cratectl fetched the upstream V3 service index and both archives over HTTPS. The downstream owned fixture used loopback HTTP. The public source did not supply the tested optional SHA-512 sidecar URL. The test independently checked every archive SHA-256 before approval, and stock client archive and lock hashes after restore. Package-signature verification, distribution and additional origins require separate evidence.
